tools.name: list_boracay_airport_transfers
tools.description: List the airport transfer packages MyBoracayGuide sells between Caticlan or Kalibo airport and hotels on Boracay Island, with the passenger types used for pricing.

tools.name: quote_boracay_airport_transfer
tools.description: Get the live price in Philippine pesos for a Boracay airport transfer by package, trip type, airport and passengers. It is the same price the myboracayguide.com booking form shows, discounts included. Books nothing.

tools.name: find_boracay_flights
tools.description: List scheduled flights at Caticlan or Kalibo airport, with the time each runs on a given date (Philippine time). Use it to match a traveller's flight number to its landing or take off time.

tools.name: create_boracay_transfer_booking_link
tools.description: Make a myboracayguide.com link that opens the transfer booking form already filled in with the trip, passengers and any traveller details known. Nothing is booked or paid: the traveller opens the link, checks the details, adds anything missing and pays on the website.

tools.name: list_boracay_activities
tools.description: List the activities and tours on Boracay that MyBoracayGuide sells (water sports, boat trips, land tours, spa, mainland adventures) with starting prices in Philippine pesos, ratings, what is included and page links. Optionally filter by category.

tools.name: quote_boracay_activity
tools.description: Get the live price in Philippine pesos for a Boracay activity, option and number of guests, the same price the activity page shows, plus the options it has. Books nothing.

tools.name: create_boracay_activity_booking_link
tools.description: Make a myboracayguide.com link that opens the booking page for an activity with the option, date and number of guests filled in. Nothing is booked or paid: the traveller enters their details and pays there.
